items.title: 独家解读丨OpenAI 们割肉、Kimi 们火拼，AI 编程下半场怎么打？
items.raw_excerpt: “从全球范围看，AI 编程已过了技术陡峭期。 但二级市场退烧后，产业一线开始了近身肉搏。 ”一家国内头部券商计算机资深分析师张淼告诉雷峰网。 最近，AI 编程市场又火了起来。 海外，Anthropic、OpenAI 为抢用户，激烈火拼，不断加码免费额度与体验时长，打起了额度战。国内，战火一路从用户心智烧到商业底牌：阿里宣称AI编程市占率第一，智谱斩获10亿美元ARR，Kimi发布K3模型，编程能力直逼全球一流。 这场 对垒背后 ，透露了一个残酷事实： AI coding（AI编程）这门生意，已进入商业绞杀、决胜突围的下半场。 同时，技术的壁垒正在降低，一些初创公司也能凭借开源模型快速追赶，在轻量任务上表现惊艳，“估值几个亿的创业公司比比皆是”，但这也把整个行业推入了接踵而至的洗牌危机中。 当大小厂商拿着 越来越 同质化的工具卷入红海，当“速成代码”在企业落地中事故频发时，我们需要重新审视 ：AI coding 这门生意的下半场，到底该怎么打？ 01 门槛变低，AI 编程已不再性感？ 在科技周期中，“技术陡峭期”意味着高耸的资金壁垒、智力垄断和用户口碑。过去几年，Anthropic 凭借在AI coding 上的技术优势，狠狠吃了一波红利。 但到了 2026 年，这条高耸的技术曲线开始平缓下来。模型之间的差距开始变小了。 一位长期专注 AI 软件领域的投资人丁洋告诉雷峰网，在 2024 年之前，要训练出一个在编程场景下“能用、好用”的底座模型，厂商需要消耗数千万美元去进行庞大的代码语料清洗与基础预训练。 但在今天，由于 Meta 的 Llama 3 系列、Kimi、以及 DeepSeek 等开源模型， 通用代码能力已经被“商品化”、甚至“标品化”了。 对初创公司而言，他们不需要去重复发明轮子。只要拿来优秀的开源底座，灌入清洗好的代码和报错修复日志进行微调，再配上一套能让 AI

excerpt_i18n.en: Following reports that OpenAI is accelerating the development of its first AI agent phone, another model maker has entered the AI terminal race. According to Leiphone, on July 13, foundational model company Stepfun (referred to as "Step") held its "Next-Generation Agent Strategy Launch" in Shanghai, officially unveiling its first native large-model AI terminal brand, STEPX. It simultaneously introduced the world’s first agent-native operating system, Step Agentic System ("Step AOS"), along with personal agent Amoo and the first native large-model agent phone, STEPX Neo. Over the past year, the AI terminal sector has been heating up, with continuous investment and events in categories such as AI glasses, AI earbuds, and AI toys. Domestic and international companies have also ramped up efforts: Li Auto launched the AI glasses Livis, Alibaba released six Quark AI glasses at once, Google first disclosed key details of its smart glasses Project Aura, and Honor took a different route with a robot phone called Robot phone. As ByteDance’s Doubao phone saw strong demand on the second-hand market, this AI terminal wave reached a new peak. Entering 2026, OpenAI is reportedly accelerating development of its first AI agent phone, targeting mass production in the first half of 2027; recently, Step has also officially entered the arena, launching its first AI agent phone.

excerpt_i18n.en: At the World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC), robots are often the most attention-grabbing exhibits. Robotic arms grasp objects, humanoid robots follow commands to perform household chores, and "world models" frequently accompany these demonstrations to explain how robots understand the environment, predict changes, and execute actions. Over time, world models have gradually become a concept exclusive to the fields of robotics and autonomous driving. However, in the view of Zhu Jun, founder of Shengshu Technology and deputy director of the Institute for Artificial Intelligence at Tsinghua University, general-purpose world models are not limited to a single scenario. Their core lies in enabling understanding, prediction, and action within the world through a unified foundation and architecture. On July 20, at the "World Model-Driven New Paradigm of AI Film and Television Productivity" forum co-hosted by Shengshu Technology and Wondershare Technology, Zhu Jun proposed that world models are neither an upgrade of video models nor an extension of language models. Instead, they represent a new paradigm where AI moves from "generating content" to "understanding the world, simulating the world, and interacting with the world in real time." Based on the same underlying foundation, the model can generate video content in pixel space and output executable actions for robots in action space. Thus, AI video and embodied intelligence are not two separate technological paths but different extensions of world modeling capabilities in the digital and physical worlds. This is also key to understanding Shengshu Technology's strategy for general-purpose world models. The public first became acquainted with the company through its large video model, Vidu. Now, its product portfolio has expanded from digital content generation to real-time interaction and physical applications.
excerpt_i18n.es: En el pabellón de la Conferencia Mundial de Inteligencia Artificial (WAIC), los robots suelen ser los expositores más llamativos. Brazos robóticos agarran objetos, robots humanoides siguen instrucciones para realizar tareas domésticas, y el "modelo del mundo" a menudo aparece junto a estas demostraciones para explicar cómo el robot comprende el entorno, predice cambios y lleva a cabo acciones. Con el tiempo, el modelo del mundo parece haberse convertido en un concepto exclusivo de la robótica y la conducción autónoma. Sin embargo, según Zhu Jun, fundador de Shengshu Technology y subdirector del Instituto de Investigación en Inteligencia Artificial de la Universidad de Tsinghua, el modelo del mundo universal no sirve para un solo escenario, sino que su núcleo es lograr la comprensión, predicción y acción sobre el mundo a través de una base y arquitectura unificadas.
